verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit ships its own built-in AI assistant. Users can delegate work to it via @coderabbitai chat and commands, one-click agentic Finishing Touches (fix findings, resolve merge conflicts, generate unit tests, run custom recipes), prompted PR improvements, and a Slack agent that investigates, plans and edits code. A community thread corroborates that it writes tests and offers committable fixes. Missing for 10: independent hands-on reports showing delegated agentic actions (e.g., merge-conflict resolution or custom recipes) completing successfully in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: One-click agentic actions that polish and extend your pull requests or merge requests: fix review findings, resolve merge conflicts, generate unit tests, simplify code, run any custom recipes.
Prompt CodeRabbit to generate its own improvements to the pull request
Bring AI-powered investigation, planning, and code editing into your Slack workspace
you can ask follow-up questions, request clarifications, challenge recommendations, or explore alternative approaches
Pause, resume, ignore reviews, request manual reviews, resolve comments, request approval, and update pull request summaries using @coderabbitai commands.
